cards.title: Run architectural pass for the first implementation slice

intentBrief.intent: Shape a rough user request into a runnable, documented task.
intentBrief.desiredOutcome: A fresh worker agent can implement the task from a bounded handoff packet.
acceptanceCriteria: Intent, outcome, constraints, non-goals, dependencies, and proof-of-done are documented.
The board card is not moved to Ready until eligibility passes.
constraints: Do not implement production code during the architectural pass.

parallelism.reason: Safe only after dependencies and write scopes are known.
